Humanoid Ground Drone. A humanoid drone: robot hands (BODY 12), two Subdermal Grips, Jump Boosters, camera with Anti-Dazzle, LL/IR/UV and Targeting Scope. Hydraulic limbs count as reinforced cyberlimbs: no Broken Arm or Leg.

Cost: 35,000eb
MOVE: 3
HP: 40
SP: 13
CN: 14
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
